# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — Glossary

## Unani Medical Terms

| Term | Arabic | Definition |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Mizaj | مزاج | Temperament; the unique combination of primary qualities (hot, cold, moist, dry) |
| Damawi | دموی | Sanguine temperament; hot and moist; dominant humor: Dam (blood) |
| Safrawi | صفراوی | Choleric temperament; hot and dry; dominant humor: Safra (yellow bile) |
| Balghami | بلغمی | Phlegmatic temperament; cold and moist; dominant humor: Balgham (phlegm) |
| Sawdawi | سوداوی | Melancholic temperament; cold and dry; dominant humor: Sawda (black bile) |
| Nuskha | نسخہ | Prescription; a classical Unani formulation |
| Hakeem | حکیم | Unani physician; a practitioner of classical medicine |
| Matab | مطب | Clinic; the practice room of a Hakeem |
| Murakkabat | مرکبات | Compound formulations; combinations of herbs |
| Mufradat | مفردات | Single herb medications |
| Ajnas-e-Ashrah | اجناس عشرہ | Ten categories used to assess Mizaj |
| Safoof | سفوف | Dry powder formulation |
| Majoon | معجون | Semi-solid electuary |
| Qurs | قرص | Tablet/disc formulation |
| Arq | عرق | Distillate; aqueous extract |
| Su-ul-Mizaj | سوء مزاج | Temperamental imbalance; dyscrasia |
| Iltihab | التهاب | Inflammation |
| Mudabbar | مدبر | Purified; detoxified (of toxic minerals/herbs) |

## Technical Terms

| Term | Definition |
|:---|:---|
| ZKB | ZAYVORA Knowledge Base — Neo4j graph of herbs, diseases, formulations |
| ZKI | ZAYVORA Knowledge Intelligence — Safety validation and evidence ranking system |
| eBMR | Electronic Batch Manufacturing Record — 21 CFR Part 11 compliant production log |
| HMAC | Hash-based Message Authentication Code — used for digital prescription signatures |
| safe_to_lock | Boolean flag; False = AI output, requires clinician review before signing |
| Schedule E(1) | Category of toxic herbs under Drugs and Cosmetics Act (India) requiring purification |
| ICP-MS | Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry — heavy metal analysis method |
| HPTLC | High Performance Thin Layer Chromatography — herbal authentication method |
| TOTP | Time-based One-Time Password — MFA method (RFC 6238) |
| RS256 | RSA + SHA-256 JWT signing algorithm |
| pgvector | PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search |
| Ajnas-e-Ashrah | 10-category Mizaj assessment framework |

## System Status Levels

| Status | Meaning |
|:---|:---|
| Prototype | Early proof-of-concept; not for demo |
| Development | Active development; feature incomplete |
| Pre-staging | Feature-complete mock; no live data |
| Pilot Candidate | Ready for controlled pilot with synthetic data |
| Closed Pilot | Live with selected real patients under supervision |
| Beta | Broader rollout; monitored |
| Production Ready | Security audited, clinically reviewed, IRB approved |
| Production | Live and fully operational |

**ZAYVORA Health OS™ current status: Pre-staging / Pilot Candidate**
